item.title: Biden awkwardly pulls trustee into spotlight and calls him ‘Barack’ at portrait unveiling
item.summary: Former President Joe Biden appeared to mistake a man for Barack Obama during a speech at Syracuse, where his portrait was unveiled at the law school.

item.title: Golf analyst Kevin Kisner says CBS showed Masters shots that 'happened ten minutes ago all day' at Augusta
item.summary: Kevin Kisner ripped CBS's Masters Sunday broadcast on Barstool's Fore Play podcast, saying the coverage was minutes behind live action at Augusta National.

item.title: Dangerous water warnings hit trendy vacation spot after powerful storm pounds area
item.summary: Hawaii health officials issued brown water advisories across Kaua'i, O'ahu, Maui and the Big Island after a Kona Low storm brought heavy rainfall.

item.title: ‘He should go’: Senate Dems turned on Swalwell ahead of resignation announcement
item.summary: Rep. Eric Swalwell announced his resignation from Congress after facing sexual misconduct allegations and mounting pressure from Senate Democrats.

item.title: Dem fundraising giant in the hot seat as GOP lawmakers demand answers over dodged subpoena
item.summary: House Republicans probe ActBlue over alleged illegal foreign donations, claiming the Democratic fundraising group obstructed their subpoenas.

item.title: Sergio Garcia apologizes for his Masters meltdown, says he regrets his actions
item.summary: Sergio Garcia apologized for smashing his driver and damaging the second tee box during the final round of the Masters, saying it has no place in golf.

item.title: Joy Behar immediately corrected after claiming Jesus didn't call himself the Messiah
item.summary: Sara Haines corrected Joy Behar on "The View" after Behar claimed Jesus never called himself the Messiah during a discussion about President Donald Trump's AI image.

item.title: Former Michigan coach Sherrone Moore receives punishment from stalking case stemming from firing
item.summary: Former Michigan head coach Sherrone Moore has avoided jail time, receiving 18 months' probation after allegedly stalking a staffer following his December firing.

item.title: Erika Kirk cancels University of Georgia TPUSA event appearance over 'serious threats'
item.summary: A Turning Point USA event at the University of Georgia proceeded despite heightened security concerns after Erika Kirk withdrew due serious threats against her.

item.title: Illegal immigrant suspected of gang ties arrested after allegedly ramming ICE officer
item.summary: Authorities say the suspect tried to flee a targeted stop, striking an agent and triggering gunfire before being hospitalized and later arrested.
